assumptions: Issuer effective-common book and shares at 2026-06-30; https://www.fairfax.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/FFH-2026-Q2-Interim-Report-Final-Bh5r66R43.pdf#page=19; annual weighted diluted history retained; independent confidence unchanged
TTM ending 2026-06-30; zero-growth rule compares TTM revenue with FY2022 revenue
growth set to zero when latest revenue is below three years earlier
sustainable tangible ROE: ten-year median capped at 25%; at least five finite observations
growth = sustainable ROE × median dividend retention, capped at 6%; residual earnings distributable
expected return is the IRR of the same perpetual distributable earnings; the 4x book cap at the required rate is a fixed payout haircut
returns use net income divided by tangible equity
valuation uses tangible book value per share
cash and debt are included in book value
equity bond yield uses median net income
Local 10-year yield: EODHD latest (US10Y.GBOND, observed 2026-10-01; checked 2026-10-01)
note: Old-algorithm Buy true was counterfactual, not the current LIVE dossier.
